Ying trained illusion magic and over the course of her life thus far, mastered it. Soon however, her mastery found herself captured by a bandit king who she eventually used her powers to escape from and became an adventurer. A year after, the Crystal War broke out, a war that sought to rid the world of magic for those outside of the elite, Ying felt obligated to join the resistance and found herself supporting on the front lines and using her mastery of magic to help aid this war. After years of war came to a close, Ying found herself rather well off and didn’t need to find work, leaving her fully to do what she wanted to do.

Ying can also heal others from almost any injury, only excluding being able to bring someone back from death or cure diseases. Her powers also allow her to float a few feet off the ground instead of walking.

During her brief year as an adventurer, Ying discovered the best way she had to make money that she enjoyed was being a prostitute.
